They are resolved via (a) tsconfig.json 'paths' entries mapping each to /Volumes/code/workspace/foundation/axi-ui/packages/<name>/src/index.ts and (b) vite.config.ts 'resolve.alias' entries mapping the same set to the same absolute filesystem targets. Hook returning the 6 columns of the tasks Ant table (status / title / prompt / cwd / updatedAt / actions). Uses antd Typography, @axi/core AxiTag, @axi/crud table primitives. All resolvable.

Hook returning avatarConfig / globalSearchNode / navGroups / topbarActions used by TodoDashboard's AxiDashboardShell. Anticipates unknown icon names with a runtime validator + console.warn fallback. All imports resolve via existing aliases.

ownerDecisionRequired: Whether to verify the versions 'vite@8.0.16', 'typescript@6.0.3', 'react@19.2.3/19.2.6', '@vitejs/plugin-react@5.2.0' against the upstream npm registry. As-of-late-2025 public versions are Vite 6.x / 7.x, TypeScript 5.x, React 19.2, @vitejs/plugin-react 5.x — Vite 8 and TypeScript 6 are forward of public. Confirm if axi-todo installs from an internal/private registry or if these are placeholders. If placeholders, the lockfile will not reproduce on a clean install.

Whether to bump antd to a patch beyond 6.4.3 once verified (semver caret currently pins at exactly 6.4.3 — if antd publishes 6.4.4 the lockfile will not pick it up without a manual 'pnpm update antd' + lockfile write). If the team prefers floating patch updates, the lockfile discipline needs to include 'pnpm update'.
Whether to align the packageManager field (pnpm@10.33.2) with the actual installed pnpm. If developers run different pnpm minors, lockfile drift will accumulate.

Whether the 5 uncommitted files represent intended-active-dev work that should land in a feature branch + PR (they are reachable, type-checkable, but currently absent from any commit). They do NOT need a separate package.json / lockfile change to land — only their source files + types review.

Whether the @axi/* path-alias strategy should be promoted into actual 'link:' package deps (one per @axi/* package in package.json + pnpm-lock entries). Current state works but couples to absolute filesystem paths under /Volumes/code/workspace/foundation/axi-ui/packages/* — any move of axi-ui breaks the build.
Whether 'pg' (Postgres driver) should remain in package.json dependencies or move to devDependencies / peerDependencies — it is backend-only and not used by the frontend bundle.
